messages:
Nora (CS): Orca onboarding: reserved GPUs are provisioned. We need a final go/no-go for tonight's priming and a clear quota plan. Can the infra team confirm target QPS and autoscale knobs?
Jin (Infra): Proposed: reserved_quota = 6k qps sustained, peak_brief = 9k for 3m. Autoscale min_replicas=5, max_replicas=18, scale_cooldown=60s. Will bake a gradual ramp to protect KV warmup.
Alex (SRE): I'll stand up enhanced logging and increase trace retention for 48h. Dashboard panels: latency p50/p95/p99, cache.kv_hit_rate, fallback.count. Add circuit breaker to prevent shared-pool egress during first 15m.
Nora (CS): Orca's success lead asked for p95 <200ms and to avoid cross-tenant fallbacks during priming. They also want a short runbook to hand to their on-call.
Tess (PM): Capture evaluation feedback: run the golden promptset and measure top-1 generation quality delta. If quality degradation >1.5% we abort. Also log variant_fallbacks and region_failovers.
Jin (Infra): Load job ready: k6 from three zones. Command: `k6 run --vus 300 --duration 20m --rps 6000 orca_profile.js`. Will execute from us-west1/us-east1/eu-west, stagger start times by 30s.
Alex (SRE): Pre-fill model cache with common prefixes. Script: `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood/v1/prime" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @orca_prefixes.json`. Monitor `cache.prefill_time` and `cache.kv_hit_rate`.
run-bot: Created channel #warmup-orca and scheduled run at 2024-12-05T03:00Z (19:00 PT). Notified on-call rotation.
Nora (CS): Checklist for tonight: 1) confirm committed quota with sales, 2) flip autoscale, 3) start prefill 25m before, 4) run k6, 5) collect eval metrics and customer feedback.
Tess (PM): Postmortem owner: Jin. CS to gather enablement notes from Orca (console UX, docs clarity, any surprises).
Jin (Infra): I'll push infra changes at T-40m, start prefill at T-25m, execute load at T=0. Will post progress in #warmup-orca.
Nora (CS): OK — I'll ping Orca 1h before and confirm their SRE will be on the bridge. Thanks everyone :rocket:
